import moment from 'moment-timezone'
import dayjs from '../src'
import utc from '../src/plugin/utc'
import timezone from '../src/plugin/timezone'

dayjs.extend(utc)
dayjs.extend(timezone)
const NY = 'America/New_York'
const LA = 'America/Los_Angeles'

it('probe', () => {
  const cases = [
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).format(Z)', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format('Z'), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format('Z')],
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).format(ZZ)', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format('ZZ'), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format('ZZ')],
    ['dayjs(str).tz(LA).format(Z)', () => dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz(LA).format('Z'), () => moment('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz(LA).format('Z')],
    ['dayjs(str).tz(LA).format(ZZ)', () => dayjs('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz(LA).format('ZZ'), () => moment('2014-06-01T12:00:00Z').tz(LA).format('ZZ')],
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).tz(LA).format(Z)', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).tz(LA).format('Z'), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).tz(LA).format('Z')],
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).utcOffset()', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).utcOffset(), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).utcOffset()],
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).format()', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format(), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format()],
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).format(YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ'), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).format('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ')],
    ['dayjs.tz(str,NY).toISOString()', () => dayjs.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).toISOString(), () => moment.tz('2014-06-01 12:00', NY).toISOString()],
  ]
  cases.forEach(([name, f, g]) => {
    let a; let b
    try { a = f() } catch (e) { a = `ERR ${e.message}` }
    try { b = g() } catch (e) { b = `ERR ${e.message}` }
    console.log(name, '=> dayjs:', a, '| moment:', b, a === b ? 'OK' : 'DIFF')
  })
})
EOF
